season_context.local_season_notes: Korea moves into a cold, dry winter where padded puffers dominate, though shoppers are shifting from black to colourful styles. Seoul's Seongsu district absorbs runway ideas within weeks. Foreign tourists drive much designer-bag spending. Seollal (Lunar New Year) in early 2027 boosts ceremonial hanbok and gifting demand.

sources.title: Shift away from black puffers (Korea Herald)
The new Seoul souvenir: a Korean designer bag (Korea JoongAng Daily)

trends.name: Mint, lemon and purple 'core' colours
trends.summary: Colour-named micro-trends are surging: a fashion app saw purple searches jump roughly sevenfold year on year, with lemon and mint also multiplying, while an online retailer reported strong sales gains for mint, lemon and olive items.

trends.name: Colourful puffers replace long black padding
trends.summary: The long black padded jacket, a Korean winter uniform, faces competition from bright puffers worn by K-pop idols; brands now plan wider colour ranges from the start, though some shoppers still prefer practical black.

trends.name: Gorpcore meets granola layering
trends.summary: Seoul dressers combine technical shells and outdoor vests with soft natural-fibre layers like linen and cotton, a mash-up of performance gear and folksy texture that Seongsu shops adapt quickly from runways.

trends.name: Y3K future-retro finishes
trends.summary: A future-retro mood brings holographic fabrics, chrome and metallic surfaces and asymmetric structural cuts inspired by AI imagery and game characters, alongside sharpened eighties shoulders and bolder colour.

trends.name: Idol-academy preppy
trends.summary: A K-pop-inflected preppy look pairs loose ties, pleated leather skirts and chunky loafers, often with plush bag charms and keyrings dangling from bags and belt loops.

trends.name: Gender-fluid styling details
trends.summary: Korean menswear increasingly borrows lace collars, pearl necklaces and cropped blazers, while women adopt strict structured suiting, according to a 2026 Seoul fashion guide naming labels like Andersson Bell and Wooyoungmi.

trends.name: Fur collars on tailored coats
trends.summary: Seoul's AW26 runways put dramatic fur collars on tailored outerwear at John & 3:21, Doucan and Greedilous, often against floral or paisley prints.

trends.name: Chanel-style tweed
trends.summary: Tweed ranged from houndstooth to linear weaves at Kwak Hyun Joo Collection, Greedilous and Munn, including oversized versions of the classic bouclé blazer for AW26.

trends.name: Inside-out suiting
trends.summary: Mmam, Kwak Hyun Joo Collection and Daily Mirror turned womenswear suits inside out for AW26, revealing linings and care labels and relocating collars to the back.

trends.name: Laddered, worn-out knitwear
trends.summary: Caruso, Adlielos and Mmam showed sweaters that look frayed, laddered or close to falling apart, giving knitwear a deliberately distressed finish for AW26.

trends.name: Oversized bows as cuffs and ties
trends.summary: Daily Mirror, Caruso and Hannah Shin used big bows in place of neckties and as sleeve cuffs, a soft romantic detail across AW26 Seoul collections.

trends.name: Duffel toggles and cape-like slit sleeves
trends.summary: AW26 outerwear at Munn, Greedilous and Sling Stone used toggle and rope closures, sometimes contrasting, while Hannah Shin and Mmam slit sleeves open for cape-like suiting and raincoats.

trends.name: Wooyoungmi's heavy wool and shaggy linings
trends.summary: Wooyoungmi's AW26 offered thick wool Chesterfield coats, high-buttoning double-breasted tailoring, knitted bodysuits, bombers and parkas lined with faux astrakhan and shaggy lamb, plus velvet-pieced technical fabrics.

trends.name: Hanbok details in everyday wear
trends.summary: This year's hanbok expo emphasised daily pieces rather than wedding or holiday dress: cropped tweed jackets, button-front skirts, jeans, mini bags and jewellery carrying traditional touches, plus ribbon hair ornaments.

trends.name: Embroidered flower-shoe heels and market silks
trends.summary: Traditional embroidered flower shoes are being reworked as modern stilettos, and Gwangjang Market textile sellers demonstrate embroidering deep blue, pale jade and sheer pink silks into garments.

trends.name: Statement ceremonial hanbok
trends.summary: Wedding and first-birthday hanbok are getting more dress-like and dramatic, with layered galrae and lifted geodeul skirts; young mothers are swinging back to vivid traditional colours after years of muted tones, helped by period K-dramas.

trends.name: K-pop-led modern hanbok campaign
trends.summary: Stray Kids' Felix fronts the government's 2026 Hanbok Wave, with five independent firms designing contemporary outfits mixing his style with traditional tailoring, promoted on billboards in New York, Paris and Milan.

trends.name: Seongsu designer handbags as souvenirs
trends.summary: Affordable Korean bag labels such as Matin Kim, Stand Oil, Marhen.J and Archivepke are booming with tourists; black ribbon and shirred polyurethane bags around 100 dollars lead, as bags avoid sizing issues.

trends.name: Trench coat reinvented
trends.summary: The trench was Seoul's dominant SS27 item: khaki, animal-print, sheer and mesh versions, plus oversized, cropped, leather and cut-apart styles at Re Rhee, Greedilous, Kelly Shin, Lie and Lie Sangbong.

trends.name: Sporty all-white looks
trends.summary: Head-to-toe white with a technical, sporty attitude appeared at Daily Mirror, Dunst, Lie, Lie Sang Bong, Sling Stone and Greedilous for SS27.

trends.name: Cobalt blue accents
trends.summary: A saturated cobalt blue showed up as full outfits and accessories at Big Park, Daily Mirror, Dunst and Hannah Shin in Seoul's SS27 shows.

trends.name: Denim in many washes and cuts
trends.summary: Jeans paired with matching tops or jackets ranged from oversized to directional shapes at Doucan, Dunst, Greedilous, HolyNumber7 and Lie, alongside HolyNumber7's micro denim shorts.

trends.name: Maxi lengths, skirts over trousers, power shoulders
trends.summary: Seoul SS27 favoured long hems and maxi skirts, skirts layered over pants, strong shoulders, bodysuits and low-rise waists anchored by bold belts.

trends.name: Loose ties and neck scarves
trends.summary: Rather than a neat knot, SS27 Seoul looks left ties hanging loose or swapped them for neck scarves, softening shirting for both men and women.

trends.name: Artist portrait prints and Hangeul lettering
trends.summary: Lie Sangbong's 40th-anniversary show used Frida Kahlo prints, safety-pinned trenches and Hangeul script on hanbok-like silk, moving from black and white into blue, red, green and florals.

trends.name: K-pop-linked street labels with instant shopping
trends.summary: Streetwear brands Dunst, General Idea and Mahagrid showed SS27 at Lotte World Tower beside an NCT anniversary runway, with QR codes letting viewers buy pieces immediately.

trends.name: Upcycled billiard cloth
trends.summary: HolyNumber7 turned discarded billiard-table felt into garments within a mostly black SS27 collection of leather half-trenches, maxi skirts and camouflage menswear.

trends.name: Kidswear: relaxed sets and mini-adult staples
trends.summary: Older context: Korean children commonly wear loose denim and sweatshirts for boys, pastel dresses, tulle skirts and baggy jeans for girls, and matching top-and-bottom sets, trench coats and oversized hoodies for both.
